opportunities.title: Chainflip Hacked, Offered the Attacker a 10% Bounty — Then the Binance Hacker Used the Same Rails to Launder $600M
opportunities.why_now: Chainflip suffered a $12M key-compromise exploit and dangled a bounty at its own attacker the same week the Binance hacker routed ~$600M through its vaults, exposing the protocol twice in one news cycle.
opportunities.angle: Investigative timeline/explainer linking the Chainflip breach to the Binance laundering flow, with a sidebar on why 'bounty negotiations' rarely stop a thief with better options elsewhere.

opportunities.title: Wrapped Monero Died Twice This Week — Same Lesson, Two Tickers
opportunities.why_now: Both xMR (Wagyu) and a second wrapped-Monero token collapsed ~99% within 48 hours from separate exploits, one blamed on a compromised web host.
opportunities.angle: Pattern-recognition piece comparing the two incidents to show wrapping privacy coins just relocates trust to a custodian/web host, not a protocol.

opportunities.title: The Binance Hacker Isn't Hiding $600M — Elliptic Just Showed You the Laundering Math
opportunities.why_now: Elliptic's fresh tracing shows $149M of the stolen funds already mixed through coinjoins as the hacker simultaneously routes hundreds of millions through THORChain and Chainflip.
opportunities.angle: Data-driven on-chain forensics piece: walk the laundering funnel step by step, cite Elliptic's numbers, and ask why cross-chain bridges keep being the exit ramp.

opportunities.title: Bitcoin Broke $57K for the First Time in Two Years — JPMorgan Says Miners Are Already Underwater
opportunities.why_now: BTC's slide below $57K amid a $1.8B liquidation wave coincided with JPMorgan pegging the production cost floor near $86K, widening the capitulation gap.
opportunities.angle: Markets explainer in the channel's signature 'already priced' voice: tie leverage unwind, miner economics, and ETF outflows into one 'what the chart isn't telling you' piece.

opportunities.title: An AI Found a Bug That Could Freeze Bitcoin Nodes by Spamming One ID 50,000 Times
opportunities.why_now: A newly disclosed consensus-layer DoS vulnerability in Bitcoin Core, surfaced via AI-assisted auditing, is a fresh base-layer security story breaking this week.
opportunities.angle: Security deep-dive on the bug mechanics, why it slipped through human review, and what AI-assisted vuln hunting means for protocol-level security going forward.
